name: Cursor Premium

meters.label: Weekly pool
meters.hint: Grok 4.5 to 4.7 and Composer 2.5, shared with the Grok apps

reset.rule: Resets once a week. The next reset time is shown under Usage at grok.com/dashboard and in Cursor's settings.
stipulations: Covers Grok 4.7, Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5 and Composer 2.5. Third-party models never draw from it.
One pool is shared by Agent in the editor, the CLI, Cloud Agents, Grok Bot and the Grok apps.
Each model drains the pool at a different rate. Cursor doesn't publish the pool size or the rates.
This plan's pool is 4x the Plus pool.
The reset isn't at a fixed weekday or hour. It falls 7 days after you joined the plan (third-party report, unconfirmed).
quota-board's Cursor collector doesn't read this pool yet. Enter readings by hand from the dashboard.

overage: When the weekly pool runs out you can wait for the reset, keep going on prepaid credit, or upgrade. Credit pays for Cursor models past the pool at per-model rates, and for third-party models from the first request at API list price. Buy credit under Additional usage credits at grok.com/dashboard/billing, or turn on Auto Top-up (off by default), which charges your card when the balance drops below a threshold you set. Credit expires 365 days after purchase. A monthly additional usage limit caps paid usage even when credit remains. If it is unset there is no cap.

how: One weekly pool for Cursor's own models (Grok 4.5 to 4.7, Composer 2.5), 4x the Plus pool, shared with the Grok apps and Grok Bot.
Auto runs in Cost mode only on individual plans. Cost mode bills as a Cursor-model request and draws from the weekly pool whatever model serves it.
Includes Cloud Agents, Automations, Bugbot code review and Grok Bot.
ext: Third-party models (Claude, GPT, Gemini and others) are billed at API list price from prepaid credit, from the first request. None are included.
Requests with your own API key don't count against included usage on individual plans.
quirks: Billing, plan changes and usage live at grok.com/dashboard, not cursor.com/dashboard.
Cursor doesn't say whether Tab completions are unlimited on the new plans.
Bugbot bills from included usage first, then from paid usage.
Premium is the tier Cursor offers legacy Pro subscribers. It includes at least twice Pro's Cursor-model usage, but no third-party allowance.
The weekly pool can feel smaller than Pro's monthly pools because Grok Bot and Cloud Agents drain the same pool (third-party report, unconfirmed).

modelTable.title: Cursor models: pay-as-you-go rates past the weekly pool
modelTable.note: These models draw from the weekly pool first. Cursor doesn't publish how fast each one drains the pool. Past the pool, prepaid credit pays these rates per 1M tokens.
modelTable.footer: Grok 4.7 input over 256k tokens is billed at 2x, up to 500k. Fast long context is 3x.

events.what: Gemini 4 Carbon intro pricing ends. From 1 Dec it costs $4 in, $0.20 cache read, $20 out per 1M tokens.
